title: 5-Day Push Pull Legs Split
desc: well-balanced and hypertrophy-focused—you’ll want to run it for at least 6–12 weeks to see solid progress and measurable results.

ex.note:
Try 3x9 at 225 this week.
	•	If it still feels like an RPE 8, go for 3x10 next week.
	•	If it feels too easy, bump it to 230 lbs for 3x8 the week after.

Stay at the same weight and aim for:
	•	3x9 this week
	•	Then 3x10 next week
	•	Once you hit 3x10 with control and no form breakdown, add 5 lbs

Stick with 100 lbs and go for 3x16+ this week.
Push volume slightly higher. Once you get to 3x18–20 clean reps → bump it to 105 lbs.
Lift with your elbows, not your hands. Keep your traps out of it. Lighter = better growth.”
Glue your elbows, push with your triceps, squeeze at the bottom.”

V-bar attachment /Sit down, lock your legs under the pad, keep chest slightly up
	•	Pull the bar to your upper chest, not behind your neck
	•	Squeeze your lats at the bottom, slowly control the return

Pull with your elbows, not your hands.”
“Squeeze your back, not your biceps.”
“Lead with the elbows and pinch at the top.
Focus on mind-muscle connection — think about pulling with your back muscles, not your arms.

Stick with the same weight
	•	Aim for 3 sets of 16–18 reps, keeping RPE at 9
	•	Focus on tempo and isolation — rear delts are small and respond best to quality, not brute force

🔥 Sample Tempo:
	•	1–2 seconds up
	•	1–2 second squeeze at top
	•	3 seconds down

🧠 Tip:

At heavier weights, using an EZ bar curl rest-pause set (e.g. 6 reps, rest 20 sec, do 2–3 more) can help push volume safely without wrecking form.
Stretch at the bottom, squeeze at the top — let the biceps do the lifting.”

Form reminders:
	•	Control both up and down phases (2 sec up, 2 sec down)
	•	Keep hips down and core tight
	•	Avoid jerking or swinging your leg

This week: try 3x8 reps @ 185
→ Once you hit 3x10, increase to 195–200 lbs
•	Primary tension: hamstrings (big stretch), glutes

This week: aim 3x15 @ 100 lbs
➡️ If you hit 15 reps cleanly at RPE 9, increase to 110 lbs next week
